text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:
- Norway's Central Bank forecast wage growth at five percent next year, while the Statistics Office three weeks ago projected wage growth at 3.6 percent in 1997.
- AC Milan won a thumping 4-1 victory over Norwegian league champions Rosenborg Trondheim in the European Cup on Wedneday.

- Zurich Insurance of Switzerland has offered to buy out Norwegian insurance group Protector ASA. Zurich Insurance has bid 230 crowns per Protector share. Protector's board has recommended that shareholders accept the offer.
- Norway's Central Bank chief Kjell Storvik on Wednesday called for a resrictive fiscal plicy and wage moderation in 1997 to keep Norway's strong economy under control.

- The removal of Esso's Odin gas rig in the North Sea has begun. Odin is the first production development on Norwegian continental shelf to be decommissioned. The project will cost 250 million crowns. Norwegian authorities will foot half of the bill.
